start.text: Welcome, {name}. The waystone remembers travellers who rest beside it.

saved.text: Done. If you faint or use a Butterfly Wing, you'll wake up right here.

rested.text: You feel refreshed. HP and SP fully restored.

start.text: Tonics, wings and fresh apples! Got loot to sell? I'll pay half what it's worth, which is more than the monsters will.

wings.text: A Fly Wing whisks you to a random spot on the same map. A Butterfly Wing takes you straight home to your return point.

start.text: New in Brightmoor? I'm Pell. Ask me anything.

fight.text: Tap a monster and you'll walk up and keep attacking. Sit to recover faster, and keep a few Red Tonics on hand.

where.text: Take the road south to the Southern Meadow. The Jellops there are harmless unless you poke them.

stronger.text: Every level gives stat points: open Stats to spend them. Sell your loot to the Tool Dealer and carry less, or you'll stop healing when your bag gets heavy.
